article.title: EcerClaw把出口網站內容、多語客服及CRM串接
article.title_en: EcerClaw links export-site content, multilingual service and CRM
article.summary: Ecer推出EcerClaw，以三個AI模組支援出口企業的網站內容、買家查詢及銷售跟進。
article.summary_en: Ecer launched EcerClaw with three AI modules for export businesses' site content, buyer inquiries and sales follow-up.
highlights: Claw Customer Service提供即時翻譯及業界術語識別，用於多語客戶支援。
Claw CRM連接潛在客戶追蹤、跟進及行銷自動化。
highlights_en: Claw Customer Service provides translation and industry-term recognition for multilingual support.
Claw CRM links lead tracking, follow-up and marketing automation.
article.why: 外貿查詢可由網站內容延伸至多語對話及CRM，出口行銷團隊可決定哪些買家問題應帶入後續銷售紀錄。
article.why_en: Export marketers can decide which buyer questions should travel from website conversations into sales records.
article.next_step: 用一項產品規格查詢，核對網站內容、客服翻譯和CRM跟進欄位是否保留相同型號及需求。
article.next_step_en: Trace one product-specification inquiry through content, translation and CRM fields, checking that model numbers and requirements stay consistent.
article.detail: Claw Editor被公司定位為協助搜尋與AI搜尋內容的編寫工具，其他模組負責接待和跟進。這些功能描述可用於檢查跨工序交接，並不能證明網站排名或訂單已提升。團隊可先挑選一個產品系列，列出買家常問的規格及術語，再評估哪些資料需要在內容、對話和銷售紀錄之間保留。
article.detail_en: Ecer positions Claw Editor for search and AI-search content, alongside service and follow-up modules. These mechanisms support handoff evaluation rather than proving rankings or order growth. Start with one product family and define the specifications and terms that must survive each handoff.
